about.title: About
about.description: Diagnostic information for bug reports and support.
about.diagnosticsDescription: Include this information when filing a bug report.
about.privacyDescription: How your audio and data are handled.
about.audioProcessingDesc: Voice Typer processes all audio locally on your device. No audio leaves your machine unless you explicitly configure a cloud speech recognition provider (OpenAI/Groq/Deepgram).
about.modelWeightsDesc: Speech recognition model weights (e.g. Whisper small.en, ~466 MB) are downloaded from HuggingFace on first use. This download reveals your IP address to HuggingFace (a US-headquartered third party). See HuggingFace's privacy policy for details.
about.cloudAsrDesc: If you configure an OpenAI / Groq / Deepgram API key, audio is streamed to that provider for transcription. The provider's privacy policy applies to the audio sent. Voice Typer never enables cloud speech recognition without your explicit opt-in.
about.voiceBiometricsDesc: Your voice recordings may be considered biometric data under Illinois BIPA and GDPR Article 9 (special categories of personal data). Voice Typer does not store raw audio after transcription completes — only the transcribed text is kept in the local history database.
about.localDataDesc: Configuration, vocabulary, templates, and history are stored in your user profile directory ({configDir}). No telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting is sent anywhere.
about.updatesDescription: Check for newer versions of Voice Typer.

audioEnhancement.title: Audio Enhancement
audioEnhancement.description: Volume ducking and noise filtering for cleaner dictation.
audioEnhancement.volumeBackendInfo: The active audio control backend. 'disabled' means ducking won't work on this platform — install the platform's optional dependency (pycaw on Windows, pyobjc on macOS).
audioEnhancement.autoDuckVolumeInfo: Reduce system volume during dictation to prevent speaker bleed into the mic. Smart Duck is built-in: if no audio is playing, the volume won't change. Cross-platform — works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
audioEnhancement.duckLevelInfo: How quiet to make system audio. 25% = whisper-quiet, 50% = slight dip.
audioEnhancement.duckLevelInfoSearch: How quiet to make system audio.
audioEnhancement.microphoneQualityInfo: Presets configure the entire filter chain for common scenarios. Choose 'Custom' for advanced control of individual filters.
audioEnhancement.microphoneQualityInfoSearch: Presets configure the entire filter chain.
audioEnhancement.presetAutoDescription: Backend picks the best filter chain for the detected noise floor and hardware. Recommended for most users.
audioEnhancement.presetStudioDescription: Light filtering for quiet, treated rooms. High-pass + gentle noise gate; neural denoiser disabled to preserve natural timbre.
audioEnhancement.presetNoisyRoomDescription: Aggressive filtering for keyboard clatter, fans, and HVAC rumble. RNNoise + strong gate + compressor for consistent ASR accuracy.
audioEnhancement.presetOffDescription: Bypass the entire filter chain. Use only with a clean signal — background noise will degrade transcription.
audioEnhancement.presetCustomDescription: Hand-pick every filter and parameter. Best for advanced users with a known acoustic environment.
audioEnhancement.highPassFilterInfo: Remove low-frequency rumble (HVAC, traffic) below the cutoff frequency.
audioEnhancement.highPassCutoffInfo: Frequencies below this are attenuated. 80Hz removes HVAC rumble. 100–150Hz also removes traffic.
audioEnhancement.noiseSuppressionInfo: Neural network denoiser. RNNoise (default, lightweight). DeepFilterNet (premium, better quality, requires torch). Speex (lightest CPU).
audioEnhancement.noiseGateInfo: Silence audio below a threshold to remove idle hiss. Uses OBS-style open/close thresholds with attack/hold/release.
audioEnhancement.gateOpenThresholdInfo: Level above which the gate opens (passes audio). -26dB is a good default for speech.
audioEnhancement.gateOpenThresholdInfoSearch: Level above which the gate opens.
audioEnhancement.gateCloseThresholdInfo: Level below which the gate closes (attenuates audio). Should be 5-10dB below open threshold.
audioEnhancement.gateCloseThresholdInfoSearch: Level below which the gate closes.
audioEnhancement.gateAttackInfo: How fast the gate opens when the signal rises above the open threshold. 5–25ms is typical for speech.
audioEnhancement.gateHoldInfo: How long the gate stays open after the signal drops below the close threshold before release begins. 100–300ms prevents flicker on pauses.
audioEnhancement.gateHoldInfoSearch: How long the gate stays open after the signal drops.
audioEnhancement.gateReleaseInfo: How fast the gate closes after the hold time expires. 100–200ms avoids abrupt cuts on trailing consonants.
audioEnhancement.gateReleaseInfoSearch: How fast the gate closes after the hold time expires.
audioEnhancement.equalizerInfo: 3-band EQ: boost mid (speech intelligibility), cut low (rumble), slight high (presence). OBS-style crossover.
audioEnhancement.eqLowInfo: Boost/cut below 800Hz. -3dB removes rumble and proximity effect.
audioEnhancement.eqMidInfo: Boost/cut 800Hz–5kHz (speech intelligibility band). +3dB improves consonant clarity.
audioEnhancement.eqHighInfo: Boost/cut above 5kHz. +2dB adds presence and brightness.
audioEnhancement.compressorInfo: Evens out loud/quiet speech for consistent speech recognition accuracy. OBS-style peak envelope with threshold/ratio/attack/release.
audioEnhancement.compressorThresholdInfo: Level above which compression starts. -18dB is a good default for speech.
audioEnhancement.compressorRatioInfo: How hard to compress. 3:1 is gentle. 10:1 is aggressive (limiter-like).
audioEnhancement.compressorAttackInfo: How fast compression engages when the signal exceeds the threshold. 2–10ms catches transients without pumping.
audioEnhancement.compressorReleaseInfo: How fast compression disengages after the signal drops below the threshold. 50–150ms avoids gain breathing on trailing syllables.
audioEnhancement.compressorOutputGainInfo: Make-up gain applied after compression to restore perceived loudness. 0dB is neutral; +3–6dB compensates for typical speech compression.
audioEnhancement.limiterInfo: Brick-wall ceiling to prevent clipping. Catches transient clicks/pops before they reach the speech recognizer.
audioEnhancement.limiterCeilingInfo: Absolute maximum output level. -6dB prevents clipping while allowing headroom.
audioEnhancement.limiterReleaseInfo: How fast the limiter recovers after catching a transient. 50–100ms is typical.
audioEnhancement.limiterReleaseInfoSearch: How fast the limiter recovers after catching a transient.
audioEnhancement.notchFilterInfo: Remove 50/60Hz electrical mains hum. Off by default — only enable if you hear a persistent low buzz.
audioEnhancement.notchFrequencyInfo: Center frequency of the notch. 50Hz for Europe/Asia mains, 60Hz for North America mains.

aiEnhancement.title: AI Enhancement
aiEnhancement.description: Rule-based grammar, punctuation, and capitalization. Runs offline — no cloud API required.
aiEnhancement.enableInfo: Apply rule-based grammar fixes, auto-punctuation, and auto-capitalization to your transcriptions. Runs entirely on-device — no text is sent to any cloud API. Off by default; turn on to apply the three sub-features below.
aiEnhancement.enableInfoSearch: Apply rule-based grammar fixes, auto-punctuation, and auto-capitalization.
aiEnhancement.fixGrammarInfo: Capitalize the pronoun 'i', restore missing apostrophes in common contractions (dont → don't, cant → can't), and collapse double spaces.
aiEnhancement.fixGrammarInfoSearch: Capitalize the pronoun 'i', restore missing apostrophes.
aiEnhancement.autoPunctuateInfo: Add a period at the end of sentences that don't already have terminal punctuation, and insert a comma at natural breath breaks (e.g. before 'and I', 'but you'). Skips URLs, file paths, and code.
aiEnhancement.autoPunctuateInfoSearch: Add a period at the end of sentences.
aiEnhancement.autoCapitalizeInfo: Capitalize the first letter of each sentence and a small set of proper nouns (weekday and month names, language names). Leaves URLs and existing capitalization untouched.
aiEnhancement.autoCapitalizeInfoSearch: Capitalize the first letter of each sentence.

vocabAutomation.title: Vocabulary Automation
vocabAutomation.description: Suggest vocabulary corrections based on transcription confidence. Off by default — enable to start collecting suggestions.
vocabAutomation.enableInfo: After each dictation, analyze low-confidence words and suggest vocabulary corrections. Suggestions above the auto-apply threshold are added to your vocabulary automatically; the rest are queued for you to review on the Vocabulary page.
vocabAutomation.enableInfoSearch: After each dictation, analyze low-confidence words.
vocabAutomation.suggestBelowConfidenceInfo: Words transcribed with confidence below this threshold are flagged for review. 0.7 is a good default — lower values (e.g. 0.5) flag only very uncertain words; higher values (e.g. 0.85) flag more aggressively but may produce false positives.
vocabAutomation.suggestBelowConfidenceInfoSearch: Words transcribed with confidence below this threshold.
vocabAutomation.autoApplyConfidenceInfo: Suggestions with confidence at or above this threshold are added to your vocabulary without asking. 0.95 is conservative — only very high-confidence corrections are auto-applied. Set to 1.0 to disable auto-apply entirely (review every suggestion manually).
vocabAutomation.autoApplyConfidenceInfoSearch: Suggestions with confidence at or above this threshold.

privacy.consentBannerDesc: Voice Typer processes voice, text, and metadata locally by default. The features below require sending specific data to third parties — click Agree to All to enable every consent at once, or toggle individual features.
privacy.huggingFaceItem: HuggingFace: downloads Whisper model weights (reveals your IP to a US third party; audio never leaves your machine).
privacy.cloudAsrItem: Cloud speech recognition (OpenAI / Groq / Deepgram): sends audio recordings for transcription when that provider is the active backend.
privacy.llmPolishItem: LLM polish: sends transcribed text (not audio) to an OpenAI-compatible LLM API for refinement.

privacy.revokeNotice: You can revoke any consent at any time by toggling it off below. Cloud features will refuse to run until the relevant consent is re-granted.
privacy.agreeToAllHint: Enable all six consent flags below. You can revoke individual consents afterward.
privacy.huggingFaceDownloadsInfo: Allows downloading Whisper model weights from huggingface.co. Reveals your IP to a US-headquartered third party (Hugging Face, Inc.). Audio itself is never sent.
privacy.voiceBiometricProcessingInfo: Allows Voice Typer to process your voice recordings locally for transcription. Voice recordings may be considered biometric data under Illinois BIPA and GDPR Article 9. Voice Typer does not store raw audio after transcription — only the transcribed text is kept.
privacy.openaiCloudAsrInfo: Allows sending audio recordings to OpenAI's Whisper API for transcription. Only takes effect when OpenAI is the active speech recognition backend AND an API key is configured.
privacy.groqCloudAsrInfo: Allows sending audio recordings to Groq's Whisper API for transcription. Only takes effect when Groq is the active speech recognition backend AND an API key is configured.
privacy.deepgramCloudAsrInfo: Allows sending audio recordings to Deepgram's nova-2 API for transcription. Only takes effect when Deepgram is the active speech recognition backend AND an API key is configured.
privacy.llmTextPolishingInfo: Allows sending transcribed TEXT (not audio) to an OpenAI-compatible LLM API for polishing. Requires an LLM API key in the Post-Processing section.
privacy.exportAllDataInfo: Download your templates and full configuration as JSON files. API keys are redacted in the config export.
privacy.agreeConfirmMessage: This enables HuggingFace downloads, cloud transcription (OpenAI / Groq / Deepgram), and LLM text polishing all at once. You can revoke any consent individually below.

history.noTranscriptionsDescription: Press your hotkey (or Caps Lock) on the Home page to dictate — your transcriptions will appear here.
history.showingCap: Showing {shown} of {total} — use search to find older
history.exportEmpty: Nothing to export — history is empty
history.exportTruncatedWarning: Export limited to {count} most recent records — use search to export older entries.
history.clearAllWithFilterMessage: This will delete all transcriptions matching the current filter. This cannot be undone.

onboarding.welcomeDescription: Voice Typer is a premium offline voice-to-text utility that runs in your system tray. Press a hotkey, speak, and your words appear as text in any application. Let's set up a few things to get you started.
onboarding.permissionsDescription: Voice Typer listens for your hotkey globally. On some platforms this needs an OS-level permission before hotkeys will work.
onboarding.permissionsNoneNeeded: No extra permission needed on this platform. Hotkeys will work out of the box.
onboarding.permissionsTestFailure: No hotkey detected. Check the permission steps above and try again.
onboarding.permissionsTestFailureBlocked: Permission still required — grant it, then try again.
onboarding.permissionsInstructionsMacosStep1: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility
onboarding.permissionsInstructionsMacosStep2: Add Voice Typer (and its key-listener helper) to the list
onboarding.permissionsInstructionsMacosStep3: Toggle the switch ON for Voice Typer
onboarding.permissionsInstructionsLinuxStep2: Install the udev rule granting group-read on /dev/input/event*
onboarding.permissionsInstructionsLinuxStep3: Log out and back in (or reboot) for the group change to take effect
onboarding.micDescription: Select the microphone you want to use for dictation. You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.noMics: No microphones detected. You can set one later in Settings.
onboarding.hotkeyDescription: Select the keyboard shortcut you'll use to start and stop dictation. Caps Lock is the default.
onboarding.modelDescription: Pick a transcription model. Smaller models are faster; larger models are more accurate. The model downloads in the background after setup.
onboarding.completeDescription: Your Voice Typer is configured and ready. Press your hotkey ({hotkey}) to start dictating. The model will download and load in the background — this may take a minute on first run (roughly 466 MB for the small model, 1.5 GB for medium).
onboarding.skipConfirmMessage: Skipping now means your microphone and hotkey may not work. You can re-run this setup wizard later from Settings → Troubleshooting, or configure individual settings in Settings.
onboarding.permissionsCheckFailed: Couldn't check permission — click Refresh to try again.
onboarding.noMicsHint: Connect a microphone or check your OS microphone permission, then click Refresh.
onboarding.modelDownloadingHint: Model will start downloading in the background — you can use the app while it loads.
onboarding.bluetoothBadgeTooltip: Bluetooth/HFP — audio quality may be limited
onboarding.consentVoiceBiometricInfo: Lets Voice Typer process your voice recordings locally for transcription. Voice recordings may be considered biometric data under Illinois BIPA and GDPR Article 9. Voice Typer does not store raw audio after transcription — only the transcribed text is kept.
onboarding.consentHuggingFaceInfo: Lets Voice Typer download Whisper model weights from huggingface.co. Reveals your IP to a US-headquartered third party (Hugging Face, Inc.). Audio itself is never sent.
onboarding.consentRequired: Please grant both consents (or use Skip) to continue.
onboarding.skipConfirmModelWarning: Skipping means no voice-biometric consent will be recorded and no model will be downloaded — dictation will be unavailable until you re-run this wizard or grant the consents in Settings → Privacy.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: The app encountered an unexpected error. Your data is safe.
errorBoundary.resetFailedNotice: Backend reset failed — clearing local state and reloading anyway.
errorBoundary.resetSettingsHint: Reset all settings to defaults and reload — useful if a bad config value caused this crash
errorBoundary.configCrashHint: The settings file may be corrupted. Try resetting to defaults.

hotkeyPicker.assignHint: Press a key to assign, or press Esc to cancel
hotkeyPicker.capsLockSrConflictWarning: Caps Lock is the default modifier key for VoiceOver / Narrator. Choosing it may break your screen reader. Consider using F2 or Ctrl+Alt+D instead.
hotkeyPicker.captureTimedOut: Capture timed out. Please try again.

hotkeyValidation.reservedUniversal: "{label}" is reserved — it conflicts with operating system or common app shortcuts
hotkeyValidation.reservedOs: "{label}" is reserved by the operating system
hotkeyValidation.singleLetterDigit: Single letters and digits can't be used as hotkeys — '{key}' would interfere with typing
hotkeyValidation.mustEndWithNonModifier: "{label}" must end with a non-modifier key (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+V, not Ctrl+Alt+V+Shift)
hotkeyValidation.reservedWindows: "{label}" is reserved by the Windows OS shell
hotkeyValidation.reservedMacosCmd: Cmd+{key} is reserved by macOS / common apps
hotkeyValidation.reservedWindowsAltShift: "{label}" is reserved by Windows for language switching
hotkeyValidation.reservedAppCtrl: Ctrl+{key} is a reserved application shortcut
hotkeyValidation.shiftLetterInterferes: Shift+{key} interferes with text capitalization or symbol input
hotkeyValidation.dictationKeyMustBeSingle: "{label}" can't be used as a dictation key — dictation key must be a single key. Use the re-paste key picker for combos.
hotkeyValidation.alreadyInUse: "{label}" is already in use by another setting. Each hotkey must be unique.
hotkeyValidation.keyNotSupported: "{label}" is not supported. Try letters, numbers, F-keys, or Space.
hotkeyValidation.dictationKeySingle: Dictation key must be a single key (no modifiers). Use the re-paste key for combos.
hotkeyValidation.dictationKeySingleShort: Dictation key must be a single key
hotkeyValidation.fnMacosOnly: Fn key is only supported on macOS
hotkeyValidation.bareModifierInterferes: Bare modifier keys (Shift, Cmd, Win) interfere with typing. Please choose a different key.

detectedIssueCodes.volume_too_low: Volume too low — speak closer to the microphone
detectedIssueCodes.volume_low: Volume is low — consider raising input gain
detectedIssueCodes.no_voice: No voice detected — try speaking during the test

errors.singleKeyOnly: Dictation key must be a single key (no modifiers). Use the re-paste key for combos.
errors.fnMacOnly: Fn key is only supported on macOS. On Windows/Linux, Fn isn't visible to apps.
errors.comboMustEndNonModifier: Combo must end with a non-modifier key (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+V, not Ctrl+Alt+V+Shift)
errors.fnMacOnlyShort: Fn key is only supported on macOS.

errors.network: Network connection issue. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Please try again in a moment.
errors.storage: Storage error. Check that you have enough disk space and the right permissions.
errors.render: The app hit a rendering error. Try reloading the page.
errors.unknown: The app encountered an unexpected error. Your data is safe.
errors.cudaOom: GPU ran out of memory. Try a smaller model, close other GPU apps, or switch to CPU mode.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknownBackend: The transcription backend hit an unexpected error. Your data is safe — try again.

connection.respawnFailedHint: Voice Typer tried to recover its backend several times and gave up. Relaunch the app, and if the problem persists, check the logs or reinstall.

pythonCrash.title: Python backend crashed
pythonCrash.body: {appName}'s Python backend exited unexpectedly with code {code} and will now exit.
pythonCrash.signalBody: {appName}'s Python backend was killed by signal {signal} and will now exit.

pythonNotFound.title: Python backend not found
pythonNotFound.body: {appName} could not find its Python backend. Please reinstall the application.

pythonStartupTimeout.title: Python backend failed to start
pythonStartupTimeout.body: {appName} could not connect to its Python backend within {seconds} seconds.

restartLoopBreak.title: {appName} cannot restart safely
restartLoopBreak.body: The Python backend is crashing on launch. After {count} attempts over {seconds} seconds, the restart loop breaker has engaged. Please check the log files and reinstall if the problem persists.
